assignments.expected_answer:
1. Dastlabki narx: 100 000 so'm. 
2. 20% oshgandan keyin: 100 000 * (1 + 0.20) = 100 000 * 1.20 = 120 000 so'm. 
3. Yangi narx 10% tushgandan keyin: 120 000 * (1 - 0.10) = 120 000 * 0.90 = 108 000 so'm. 
Oxirgi narx: 108 000 so'm.

assignments.expected_answer: The Present Simple describes habits, routines, facts, and general truths (e.g., 'I drink coffee every morning'). The Present Continuous describes actions happening now or temporary situations (e.g., 'I am drinking coffee now').

assignments.question: Explain how to form comparative and superlative adjectives in English. Provide one example for a short adjective and one for a long adjective for both forms.
assignments.expected_answer: Comparative adjectives compare two things (e.g., 'taller', 'more beautiful'). Superlative adjectives compare three or more things and show the highest degree (e.g., 'tallest', 'most beautiful'). Short adjectives add '-er'/'the -est' (e.g., 'big - bigger - biggest'). Long adjectives use 'more'/'the most' (e.g., 'expensive - more expensive - most expensive').

assignments.question: Explain the difference between countable and uncountable nouns. When do we use 'some', 'any', 'much', and 'many' with them? Give one example for each quantifier.
assignments.expected_answer: Countable nouns can be counted and have plural forms (e.g., 'apples', 'books'). Uncountable nouns cannot be counted individually and do not usually have plural forms (e.g., 'water', 'information'). 'Some' is used with both countable and uncountable nouns in affirmative sentences and offers. 'Any' is used with both in negative sentences and questions. 'Many' is used with countable nouns in questions and negative sentences. 'Much' is used with uncountable nouns in questions and negative sentences.

1. yoz

3. qur
assignments.expected_answer:
1. Yoz: yozdi (aniq), yozildi (majhul), yozdirdi (orttirma), yozishdi (birgalik).
2. O'qi: o'qidi (aniq), o'qildi (majhul), o'qitdi (orttirma), o'qishdi (birgalik).
3. Qur: qurdi (aniq), qurildi (majhul), qurdirdi (orttirma), qurishdi (birgalik), qurindi (o'zlik).
Izoh: Har bir nisbat harakatning kim tomonidan bajarilganini yoki kimga qaratilganini bildiradi.

assignments.question:
Quyidagi gaplarda tushirib qoldirilgan tinish belgilarini (vergul, tire) to'g'ri qo'ying va izohlang:
1. Daraxtlar gullar o'tlar bahorning ilk xabarchilari.
2. U bozorga bordi meva sabzavot non sotib oldi.
3. Hamma narsa stol kitob daftar qalam joy-joyida edi.
assignments.expected_answer:
1. Daraxtlar, gullar, o'tlar – bahorning ilk xabarchilari. (Uyushiq egalar orasida vergul, ulardan keyin umumlashtiruvchi so'z kelgani uchun tire.)
2. U bozorga bordi, meva, sabzavot, non sotib oldi. (Uyushiq to'ldiruvchilar orasida vergul, "bordi" va "sotib oldi" kesimlari orasida vergul.)
3. Hamma narsa: stol, kitob, daftar, qalam joy-joyida edi. (Umumlashtiruvchi so'zdan keyin uyushiq bo'laklar kelgani uchun ikki nuqta, uyushiq bo'laklar orasida vergul.)

Quyidagi gaplarda ajratilgan bo'laklarni toping, ularning turini aniqlang va tushirib qoldirilgan tinish belgilarini qo'ying:
1. U yugurib kelib holsizlangancha o'tirdi.

assignments.question:
Quyidagi so'zlarni morfemik tahlil qiling va ularning qaysi usulda yasalganligini ko'rsating:
1. Bilimdon
2. Qo'shiqchi
3. Kitobxonlik
assignments.expected_answer:
1. Bilimdon: "Bil" (o'zak fe'l) + "-im" (ot yasovchi) + "-don" (ot yasovchi). Affiksatsiya usuli bilan yasalgan.
2. Qo'shiqchi: "Qo'sh" (o'zak fe'l) + "-iq" (ot yasovchi) + "-chi" (ot yasovchi). Affiksatsiya usuli bilan yasalgan.
3. Kitobxonlik: "Kitob" (o'zak ot) + "xon" (ot yasovchi) + "-lik" (ot yasovchi). Affiksatsiya usuli bilan yasalgan.

assignments.question: So'z yasalishi va so'z tarkibi tushunchalarini izohlang. O'zbek tilida so'z yasalishining asosiy usullarini sanab o'ting.
assignments.expected_answer: So'z yasalishi – mavjud so'zlar yoki asoslardan yangi so'zlarning hosil bo'lish jarayoni. So'z tarkibi – so'zning qismlarga (o'zak, qo'shimcha) bo'linishi. O'zbek tilida so'z yasalishining asosiy usullari: affiksatsiya (qo'shimchalar yordamida, masalan: ish+chi), kompozitsiya (ikki yoki undan ortiq so'zning qo'shilishi, masalan: osh+qovoq), konversiya (bir so'z turkumidan ikkinchisiga o'tish, masalan: yashil (sifat) -> yashil (ot)).

lessons.objective: O'quvchilar nutq uslublarining (badiiy va ilmiy) o'ziga xos xususiyatlarini, ularning farqlarini va qo'llanilish doirasini tushunadilar.

plan.description: Maqsadi (ma'lumot berish, faktlar, aniqlik), xususiyatlari (terminologiya, aniqlik, mantiqiylik, emotsionalliksiz), qo'llanilish doirasi (darsliklar, ilmiy maqolalar, referatlar).

assignments.question:
Quyidagi matn parchalarini o'qing va ularning qaysi nutq uslubiga mansub ekanligini aniqlab, xususiyatlarini izohlang:
1. "Quyosh oltin sochlarini yerga yoyib, tabiatni uyg'otardi. Har bir gul, har bir yaproq uning mehridan bahra olardi."
2. "Fotosintez – o'simliklarning quyosh energiyasini kimyoviy energiyaga aylantirish jarayoni bo'lib, bu jarayonda karbonat angidrid va suvdan foydalaniladi."
assignments.expected_answer:
1. **Badiiy uslub.** Xususiyatlari: obrazlilik ("oltin sochlarini yerga yoyib"), jonlantirish ("tabiatni uyg'otardi", "gul, yaproq mehridan bahra olardi"), his-hayajonli ifoda. Maqsadi: o'quvchida estetik taassurot uyg'otish.
2. **Ilmiy uslub.** Xususiyatlari: aniqlik, faktlarga asoslanganlik, terminologiya ("fotosintez", "quyosh energiyasi", "kimyoviy energiya", "karbonat angidrid"), emotsionalliksiz, mantiqiy bayon. Maqsadi: ma'lumot berish.

assignments.expected_answer: Badiiy uslubning maqsadi estetik ta'sir ko'rsatish, his-tuyg'ularni ifodalashdir. Til xususiyatlari: obrazlilik, metafora, jonlantirish kabi tasviriy vositalar, hissiy-ekspressiv so'zlar. Tipik janrlar: she'r, hikoya, roman. Ilmiy uslubning maqsadi ma'lumot berish, faktlarni aniq bayon etishdir. Til xususiyatlari: aniqlik, mantiqiylik, terminologiya, bir xil sintaktik qurilmalar. assignments.expected_answer: Ehtimollik: 10 ta son ichida 5 ta juft son bor (2, 4, 6, 8, 10). Ehtimollik = 5/10 = 1/2 = 0.5. Ma'lumotlar to'plami: {2, 3, 3, 5, 5, 5, 8}. assignments.question:
Combine the following pairs of sentences using 'who', 'which', or 'that'. Omit the relative pronoun if possible.
1. This is the man. He helped me yesterday.
2. I bought a new car. It is very fast.
3. She showed me the book. She read it last week.
4. We visited the museum. It has many ancient artifacts.
5. The girl is my sister. She is wearing a red dress.
assignments.expected_answer:

Imagine you are applying for a summer internship at a local company. Write a short formal letter of application (approx. 100-120 words), including:
- Your address and date
- The recipient's address (use a fictional company and contact person)
- A formal salutation
- A brief introduction stating your purpose
- A paragraph about your relevant skills/qualifications (e.g., good at English, computer skills, hardworking)
- A formal closing and your signature.
assignments.expected_answer:
123 Main Street
Anytown, 12345
Uzbekistan

October 26, 2023

Mr. John Smith
HR Manager
ABC Company
456 Business Avenue
Anytown, 12345

Dear Mr. Smith,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Summer Internship position advertised on your company's website. As a motivated 9th-grade student with a strong academic record, I am eager to gain practical experience in a professional environment.

I possess strong English language skills, proficiency in basic computer applications, and a diligent work ethic. I am a quick learner and believe I can contribute positively to your team while developing valuable professional skills.

Thank you for considering my application. I have attached my short CV for your review and look forward to hearing from you soon.

Sincerely,

lessons.objective: O'quvchilar o'zbek tilidagi keng tarqalgan frazeologizmlarni bilib oladilar va ularning ma'nolarini tushuntira oladilar.

plan.title: Frazeologizm tushunchasi
plan.description: Frazeologizm nima ekanligini, uning so'z birikmasidan farqini tushuntirish. Frazeologizmlarning nutqdagi ahamiyati haqida suhbatlashish.

plan.title: Keng tarqalgan frazeologizmlar
plan.description: O'zbek tilidagi bir nechta keng tarqalgan frazeologizmlarni (masalan, 'qo'l uchida', 'ko'z ochib yumguncha', 'og'ziga talqon solmoq') misollar bilan tushuntirish. Ularning ma'nolarini aniqlash.

plan.title: Frazeologizmlarni qo'llash
plan.description: O'quvchilarga berilgan frazeologizmlar bilan gaplar tuzishni taklif qilish. Matnlardan frazeologizmlarni topish va ularning ma'nolarini izohlash.

assignments.question: Quyidagi frazeologizmlarning ma'nosini yozing va ular bilan bittadan gap tuzing: 'qo'l uchida', 'ko'z ochib yumguncha'.
assignments.expected_answer: Qo'l uchida - yuzaki, e'tiborsiz. Gap: U ishni qo'l uchida bajardi. Ko'z ochib yumguncha - juda tez, bir zumda. Gap: Ko'z ochib yumguncha bahor keldi.

criteria.name: Frazeologizm ma'nosini to'g'ri tushuntirish

criteria.name: Frazeologizmni gapda to'g'ri qo'llash
criteria.description: Tuzilgan gaplarda frazeologizmlar ma'no jihatdan mos kelganligi.

criteria.name: Grammatik to'g'rilik
criteria.description: Tuzilgan gaplarning grammatik jihatdan xatosiz ekanligi.

assignments.question: Beshta frazeologizm keltiring va ularning ma'nolarini izohlang.
assignments.expected_answer: 1. Qo'l uchida ishlash - beparvolik bilan, yuzaki ishlash. 2. Ko'ngli bo'sh - tez ta'sirlanuvchan, yig'loqi. 3. Og'ziga talqon solmoq - jim turishga majbur qilmoq. 4. Bosh qotirmoq - biror narsa haqida chuqur o'ylamoq. 5. Burni ko'tarilmoq - kekkaymoq, manmanlik qilmoq.

criteria.name: Frazeologizmlarning to'g'riligi

mistakes.correction: Uning boshi osmonda edi (maqtanchoq, gerdaygan ma'nosida).

mistakes.correction: Uning tili bor edi (gapga usta, notiq ma'nosida).

lessons.objective: O'quvchilar o'zbek tilining asosiy imlo qoidalari va tinish belgilaridan to'g'ri foydalanishni o'rganadilar.

plan.title: Imlo qoidalariga kirish
plan.description: Imlo nima ekanligini va uning ahamiyatini tushuntirish. O'zbek tilidagi asosiy imlo qoidalarini eslatish (masalan, unli va undoshlar imlosi).

plan.title: Tinish belgilari va ularning vazifalari
plan.description: Asosiy tinish belgilari (nuqta, vergul, so'roq, undov, tire, ikki nuqta, tirnoq) va ularning gapdagi vazifalarini misollar yordamida tushuntirish.

plan.title: Amaliy mashqlar va xatolar tahlili
plan.description: Matnlardagi imlo va tinish belgilari xatolarini topish va tuzatish. O'quvchilarning yozma ishlaridagi tipik xatolarni tahlil qilish.

assignments.question: Quyidagi matndagi imlo va tinish belgilari xatolarini tuzatib yozing: 'Men maktabga bordim ammo darsga kechikdim u yerda do'stlarim meni kutishardi'

assignments.expected_answer: 1. Gap bo'laklarini ajratish (vergul): Men kitob o'qidim, yozdim, chizdim. 2. Gapning tugallanganligini ifodalash (nuqta): Dars tugadi. 3. So'roq mazmunini bildirish (so'roq belgisi): Siz qayerga borasiz? 4. His-hayajonni ifodalash (undov belgisi): Salom, do'stlar!

lessons.objective: O'quvchilar insho yozishning asosiy bosqichlarini (mavzu tanlash, reja tuzish, xulosa chiqarish) o'zlashtiradilar.

plan.title: Insho tushunchasi va uning turlari
plan.description: Insho nima ekanligini, uning maqsadini tushuntirish. Inshoning asosiy turlari (hikoya, tasvir, muhokama) haqida ma'lumot berish.

plan.title: Insho yozish bosqichlari
plan.description: Mavzu tanlash, reja tuzish (kirish, asosiy qism, xulosa), asosiy qismni yoritish, xulosa chiqarish qoidalarini misollar yordamida tushuntirish.

plan.title: Amaliy mashg'ulot: reja tuzish
plan.description: Berilgan mavzu bo'yicha insho rejasi tuzish. Rejaning har bir bandini qisqacha yoritish. O'quvchilarning rejalarini muhokama qilish.

assignments.question: Quyidagi mavzu bo'yicha insho rejasi tuzing: 'Kitob – bilim bulog'i'.
assignments.expected_answer: 1. Kirish: Kitobning inson hayotidagi o'rni. 2. Asosiy qism: a) Kitobning bilim manbai ekanligi. b) Kitob o'qishning foydalari. c) Kitob turlari va ularning ahamiyati. 3. Xulosa: Kitobga do'st bo'lishga chaqiriq.

criteria.name: Rejaning to'liq va mantiqiy tuzilishi
criteria.description: Rejaning kirish, asosiy qism va xulosa qismlari mavjudligi va ularning mantiqiy ketma-ketligi.

criteria.name: Mavzuni to'liq qamrab olish
criteria.description: Reja bandlarining berilgan mavzuni har tomonlama yoritishga qaratilganligi.

criteria.name: Bandlarning aniq va tushunarli ifodalanishi
criteria.description: Reja bandlarining qisqa, aniq va mazmunli qilib yozilganligi.

assignments.question: Insho yozishda mavzu tanlash, reja tuzish va xulosa chiqarish bosqichlarini qisqacha izohlang.
assignments.expected_answer: Mavzu tanlash: Insho yozishdan oldin qiziqarli va tushunarli mavzuni tanlash. Reja tuzish: Inshoning asosiy g'oyalarini, kirish, asosiy qism va xulosani tartibga solish. Xulosa chiqarish: Inshoning asosiy fikrlarini umumlashtirib, yakuniy xulosani bayon etish.

criteria.name: Bosqichlarning to'g'ri izohi
criteria.description: Har bir bosqichning mohiyatini to'g'ri tushuntirish.

criteria.description: Tushuntirishlarning aniqligi va tushunarliligi.

criteria.name: Tushuntirishning ixchamligi
criteria.description: Javobning qisqa va lo'nda bayon etilishi.

mistakes.explanation: Rejasiz insho tartibsiz va mantiqsiz bo'lishi mumkin.

mistakes.explanation: Xulosa qisqa bo'lishi bilan birga, mavzuni yakunlovchi fikrni to'liq ifodalashi kerak.

mistakes.fragment: Inshoda faqat o'z fikrlarimni yozishim kerak.

mistakes.explanation: Fikrlarni dalillarsiz bayon etish inshoning ishonchliligini kamaytiradi.
